name: Corn (ZC) Futures Term Structure Analysis
description: Analyzes corn (ZC) futures term structure — contango vs backwardation and carry cost for a long position. Uses two futures_continuation series with spread_depth=1 (M1-M2) and spread_depth=2 (M1-M3) with NoAdjustment to derive true front, second, and third month prices. Computes M2-M1 spread (positive = contango, negative = backwardation), annualized carry cost assuming ~60 day inter-contract spacing, and roll yield implications. Output: (1) Current term structure snapshot with bar chart and summary stats, (2) Historical spread time series with 20-day SMA and contango/backwardation shading, seasonal carry profile by calendar month, and distribution stats (% days contango/backwardation, average carry, current percentile).
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN (ZC) FUTURES TERM STRUCTURE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Analyzes contango vs backwardation and carry cost for a long corn position.
#
# Data:
#   - ZC-Futures with NoAdjustment for true price levels
#   - Two futures_continuation nodes:
#     spread_depth=1 → M1 price, carry (M1/M2 - 1), spread (M1 - M2)
#     spread_depth=2 → spread (M1 - M3)
#
# Key Metrics:
#   - M2-M1 spread: positive = contango, negative = backwardation
#   - Annualized carry cost: (M2/M1 - 1) × (365/60)
#   - Roll yield: negative in contango (costly for longs), positive in backwardation
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source()()

# Continuation with spread_depth=1: front vs 2nd nearby
cont1 = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# Continuation with spread_depth=2: front vs 3rd nearby
cont2 = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=2
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Derive Contract Month Prices ---
# M1 = front month (unadjusted close)
m1_price = cont1.c

# spread_depth=1: spread = M1 - M2, so M2 = M1 - spread
spread_m1m2 = cont1.spread
m2_price = m1_price - spread_m1m2

# spread_depth=2: spread = M1 - M3, so M3 = M1 - spread
spread_m1m3 = cont2.spread
m3_price = m1_price - spread_m1m3

# --- Key Spread & Carry Metrics ---
# M2 - M1 spread: positive = contango, negative = backwardation
m2m1_spread = -spread_m1m2

# Annualized carry cost: (M2/M1 - 1) × (365/60)
# ~60 days approximate spacing between corn contract months
carry_ratio = m2_price / m1_price - 1
annualized_carry = carry_ratio * (365.0 / 60.0)

# 20-day SMA of the M2-M1 spread
spread_sma = ma(period=20)(m2m1_spread)

# Contango/backwardation zone flags (for shading bands)
is_contango = m2m1_spread > 0
is_backwardation = m2m1_spread < 0

# Current spread percentile (over 252-day lookback ≈ 1 year)
spread_pctile = percentrank(period=252)(m2m1_spread)

# --- Calendar Month Labels (for seasonal analysis) ---
ts = index()
month_end = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(ts)

# Monthly spread: capture M2-M1 spread at month-end
prev_month_spread = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(month_end, m2m1_spread)
monthly_spread = (m2m1_spread - prev_month_spread) if month_end else 0.0 / 0.0

# Month number for seasonal grouping
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
nan_flag = m2m1_spread / m2m1_spread
month_label_seasonal = month_num * nan_flag

# =============================================================================
# PANEL 1 — CURRENT TERM STRUCTURE SNAPSHOT
# =============================================================================

# Pivot M1, M2, M3 prices to long format for bar chart
term_struct = pivot_longer(names=['M1 (Front)', 'M2 (Second)', 'M3 (Third)'])(m1_price, m2_price, m3_price)

# Bar chart: current term structure snapshot
xy_bars(
    title='Corn Term Structure Snapshot (Latest Prices)',
    category='1. Current Term Structure',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Price (¢/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Contract Month',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='M1 (Front)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='M2 (Second)', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='M3 (Third)', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    order=1
)(m1_price, m2_price, m3_price)

# Summary table: current term structure metrics
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Term Structure Summary',
        row_size=6,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['M1 Price', 'M2 Price', 'M3 Price', 'M2−M1 Spread (¢/bu)', 'Annualized Carry (%)', 'Spread Percentile (1Y)'],
        col_headers=['Current'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Current Term Structure',
    order=2
)(m1_price, m2_price, m3_price, m2m1_spread, annualized_carry, spread_pctile)

# =============================================================================
# PANEL 2 — HISTORICAL TERM STRUCTURE
# =============================================================================

# Time-series of M2-M1 spread with SMA and contango/backwardation bands
xy_lines(
    title='M2−M1 Spread: Contango vs Backwardation Over Time',
    category='2. Historical Term Structure',
    y_axis_label='M2−M1 Spread (¢/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Date',
    area=False,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero (Flat)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango Zone', color=Color.Red, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation Zone', color=Color.Emerald, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='M2−M1 Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d SMA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(is_contango, is_backwardation, m2m1_spread, spread_sma))

# Seasonal profile: average M2-M1 spread by calendar month
xy_bars(
    title='Seasonal Carry Profile: Average M2−M1 Spread by Month',
    category='2. Historical Term Structure',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg M2−M1 Spread (¢/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(m2m1_spread, label=month_label_seasonal)

# Summary table: historical statistics
# is_contango mean = fraction of days in contango
# is_backwardation mean = fraction of days in backwardation
# Contango-only average: where(is_contango, m2m1_spread) with Mean gives avg when positive
contango_spread = where(is_contango, m2m1_spread)
backwardation_spread = where(is_backwardation, m2m1_spread)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Historical Carry Statistics',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['% Days in Contango', '% Days in Backwardation', 'Avg Spread in Contango (¢)', 'Avg Spread in Backwardation (¢)', 'Current Spread Percentile (1Y)'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. Historical Term Structure',
    order=3
)(is_contango, is_backwardation, contango_spread, backwardation_spread, spread_pctile)
